mask_semantics: White=ray direction inside nominal source frustum union; black=outside. Diagnostic approximate coverage, not independently verified geometry confidence.
method: Post-composite original v1 RGB; keep supported pixels exactly and replace unsupported pixels by RGB 128. The mask is NOT supplied to H3.
limits: WorldCrafter source images do not strictly match nominal camera calibration.
Ray coverage does not certify reconstruction correctness or completeness.
Original v1 lighting and indirect effects of prior geometry are retained; this is RGB evidence withholding, not a geometry/lighting ablation.

source_manifest.known_limit: Original v1 room shell retained, including hypothesized right wall. Missing details are not necessarily literal holes.
